task_requirements.requirement: Report observable signs, event time and evidence. Do not claim a violation when the conclusion requires invisible records, postings, reconciliation or bank-system data.

task_requirements.source_locator: sections 2, 3 and 6; FAQ B8, F30, F31, F32
task_requirements.requirement: The team must research relevant public normative sources, identify applicable rules and justify the mapping to visible events. No exhaustive violation list or cashier regulation is supplied. FAQ identifies Kazakhstan sources; it also accepts references without exact clauses and open documents of other banks.
The result assists human review; it is not a final legal or disciplinary conclusion.
Video processing is local. Do not send videos, frames or their descriptions to cloud AI services.

verified_detection_rules.normative_summary: Cash at the workstation belongs to the current customer; previously accepted cash is kept in designated lockable storage.
verified_detection_rules.observable_predicate: Across supplied frames, clearly track cash accepted from customer A, customer A finishing and leaving, and a distinct customer B starting a new cash transaction while the same earlier cash remains exposed on the desk outside designated storage.
required_conditions: visible acceptance of customer A cash
visible A departure and distinct B new transaction
visible continuity of the earlier cash pile outside storage
exclude: cash of the current customer during an ongoing operation
two people jointly involved in one transaction
unclear cash ownership or unseen transition
closed safe without evidence of its lock state
verified_detection_rules.interpretation: This temporal predicate is an operational visual implementation of clause 20; no fixed number of seconds is asserted to be a legal threshold.

verified_detection_rules.normative_summary: A cashier must not leave the workstation before finishing customer service.
verified_detection_rules.observable_predicate: Clearly observe a customer cash-acceptance transaction underway, the cashier leaving the workstation and that same customer still waiting with the visibly unfinished transaction. Require the before/after sequence, not a lone empty chair.
required_conditions: same customer visibly remains awaiting completion
exclude: standing to use nearby equipment while remaining at workstation
empty chair without preceding active transaction
verified_detection_rules.interpretation: Whether service is visibly unfinished is an operational observation, not an inference about invisible banking-system completion.

source_gap: The task contains no closed list. This first baseline implements only two observable predicates backed by clauses 20 and 22. It does not cover the whole law or all labelled violations. No claims are made about unseen records, lock status, identity-document checks, phone use, receipt issuance, or omitted counting. Full current consolidated text was not directly downloadable; source text was obtained from the official indexed page and history.
automatic_positive_forbidden_without_ext: ordinary handover, receipt, counting or return of cash
ordinary use of a laptop, phone or identity document
a closed safe without visible proof about the lock
presence of banknotes on a desk during an ongoing operation
a step not shown in sparse frames
an assumed amount, authenticity result, posting, reconciliation or authorization

technical_policy.completed_schema: adapter converts complete validated window outputs into src.forte.contracts.validate_candidate schema
technical_policy.event_time: one of the timestamps supplied with the current frame window
technical_policy.description: visible evidence plus a source reference; no unseen motive or legal guilt
technical_policy.negative: Only after all planned windows were successfully analyzed and no unresolved evidence remains; no_violation means no enabled criterion detected under the sampling protocol, not proof of legal compliance.
technical_policy.partial_positive: Keep detected events in a private partial-outcome record, but reject the final candidate if any required window is incomplete, timed out, truncated or uncertain under the current strict contract.
technical_policy.technical_failure: Invalid JSON, refusal, truncation, timeout, decoding failure and model unavailability are separate failed outcomes and never no_violation.
technical_policy.missing_coverage: Unseen intervals are not negative examples. Finite frame sampling cannot certify every moment of the original video.

model_schema.uncertainty_reason: string; empty only for complete results

technical_policy.window_context_limit: Local: up to 16 frames, planned 0.5-second interval, overlap 2. Overview: one window of 16 uniformly sampled frames spanning the full video. Each request receives kind and actual timestamps, no cross-window model memory. Overview gaps do not establish omitted actions, unchanged ownership or uninterrupted object continuity. Finite sampling is not continuous coverage.

normative_source.title: Rules on cash operations and collection operations, NB RK Board Resolution 29 November 2019 No. 231
normative_source.retrieval: Official Adilet text returned by web search; direct page fetch timed out / JS challenge. Exact public law passages and clause numbers inspected in indexed official source. No legal applicability certification.
normative_source.applicability: Second-tier banks and the entities named in section 1. This is the appropriate institutional scope for the supplied bank cashier task, unlike National Bank branch-only rules.

excluded_candidates.reason: Clause 20 requires presence at acceptance/counting, but a later recount is not proof that the required initial count was omitted. Sparse frames cannot establish that absence.
No applicable verified rule in the chosen subset; object use alone is not a violation.
No applicable specific predicate with all conditions was verified in this subset; presence/open state alone is insufficient.
Unobserved actions between frames and digital-document alternatives make omission claims unsupported.

independent_accuracy: NOT RUN: criteria audit only; development baseline will not be independent final evaluation.
